en-GB.title: Renovation Cost and ROI
en-GB.summary: RED Level 2 lesson 025: Renovation Cost and ROI.
en-GB.body: This localized RED Level 2 lesson develops practical competency in Renovation Cost and ROI. It preserves the English lesson's core learning purpose: evaluate how the decision affects other parts of a real-estate transaction or portfolio, including financing, cash flow, return, risk, legal obligations, timing, and management where applicable. Learners should verify jurisdiction-specific lending, tax, contract, title, environmental, securities, and property rules with qualified local professionals. The goal is informed analysis, not a recommendation of a particular investment or transaction.
